name: How long does it take to install a kitchen island?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a kitchen island?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen island installation typically takes between one and three weeks once cabinetry and stone materials arrive. The timeframe depends directly on utility integration and floor prep. A basic dry island—which features only cabinets and a countertop—installs quickly within a few days. If your project includes cutting concrete for plumbing, roughing in dedicated electrical circuits, or venting a cooktop hood, construction takes longer to accommodate inspections and trade coordination. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms coordinates these phases from initial planning through final trim to minimize household disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical island installation takes one to three weeks once materials arrive, depending on whether plumbing, electrical work, or concrete trenching is required.
